# AI Reference

> A reference repository for adopting AI coding agents: a LiteLLM gateway as the single entry point, OpenCode as the primary client (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI wired to the same gateway), tool-agnostic context (AGENTS.md, Agent Skills, MCP), and personal and enterprise profiles. Everything recommended is permissively licensed.

Start with the overview, then the doc that matches the task. Config files carry comments explaining why; JSON files are explained in the sibling README.

## Core docs

- [Overview and architecture](docs/00-overview.md): the three layers and the design principles
- [Models](docs/01-models.md): the alias ladder, vendor catalog, selection questions
- [Gateway](docs/02-gateway-litellm.md): LiteLLM config anatomy, routing, keys, observability
- [OpenCode](docs/03-opencode.md): config precedence, provider block, agents, commands, skills, MCP, permissions
- [Other clients](docs/04-other-clients.md): Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, SDKs through the gateway
- [Agents, skills, commands](docs/05-agents-skills-commands.md): design rules and the eval workflow
- [Repository conventions](docs/06-repo-conventions.md): making any repo AI-ready
- [Security and privacy](docs/07-security-privacy.md): threat model, sandboxing, prompt injection, incidents
- [Enterprise profile](docs/08-enterprise-profile.md): policy, controls, compliance mapping, rollout
- [Workflows](docs/09-workflows.md): day-to-day playbooks
- [Troubleshooting](docs/10-troubleshooting.md)
- [Community skills](docs/11-community-skills.md): license and safety gates, verdicts on third-party tools
- [Roadmap](docs/12-roadmap.md): researched backlog and status
- [Local inference](docs/13-local-inference.md): hardware sizing, context window, speculative decoding
